services.name: Culinary Program
services.desc: LA Cocina de Gloria Molina Culinary Programs provides cooking class and educational tasting experiences to learn more about the diverse range of Mexico’s culinary art and culture. This series highlights the diversity of Mexico’s cooking culture by focusing on new takes of traditionally made dishes, and plant-based, healthy alternatives. These classes are hands-on interactive cooking classes, where students prepare a dish featured by the selected guest chef. This series highlights the beauty of Mexico by focusing on one state, region or dish offering a hands-on learning experience and a taste of Mexico's culinary landscape without the need to travel. These cooking classes are interactive.
